detail: Inference error: [StatusCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT] [request id: <id_unknown>] unexpected shape for input 'input' for model 'roads'. Expected [-1,160,160,3], got [1,292,952,3]. NOTE: Setting a non-zero max_batch_size in the model config requires a batch dimension to be prepended to each input shape. If you want to specify the full shape including the batch dim in your input dims config, try setting max_batch_size to zero. See the model configuration docs for more info on max_batch_size.
